description: Today is Wednesday. What day of the week will it be 100 days from today?
solution_sketch: Weekdays cycle every 7 days, so only 100 mod 7 matters. Since 98 = 14 × 7, we have 100 mod 7 = 2. Advance two weekdays from Wednesday: Thursday, Friday.
difficulty_rationale: The naive route tries to count 100 days on fingers and drops a digit. The insight is that 7 × 14 = 98, so 100 days is 14 full weeks plus 2, and the weekday only shifts by that remainder. Once the reader spots the mod-7 idea, Wed + 2 = Fri is one step. Findable cold, not recalled.
